peoples_entries.name: Caravaneers of the Catch & The Twins
peoples_entries.note: Multi-ethnic trans-divide corridor roster spanning The Twins (Al-Qaranan twin-volcano pass, Route A Dark-Tube Road & Route B Steaming-Stone Dash) and The Catch hyperarid alkali-salt basin (Stair Hill Arcology, Kolli, Arfwai, Bitta, Lasso, Salt al-Ban halite pans, and White Gills): Brotherhood of the Two Horns pass-masters, Train of Jabal Dasri salt-syndics & halite teamsters, Izani lava-tube pack-masters, anti-Stalker caravan outriders, Yuni oilskin wagon-factors, Geomancer explosive sappers, Stair polyglot well-bailiffs, Dead-Bore salvage divers, and White Gills lung-salt smugglers (tools/garments/cultures/catch_caravans.py)

peoples_entries.name: Laitwal Glaziers (The Mara)
peoples_entries.note: Orientalized Tungang-Xanadu diaspora of Laitwal (Lightwall, kits/tungang/PLAN.md sections 1.4-1.5): 0.94 scale compact tunnel-born opal-miners, potch-delvers, moonglass cutters, lens-grinders, and loj stewards with pale colourless skin, very large nocturnal eyes with eyeshine, cropped hair, and long bare tactile fingertips (tools/garments/cultures/xanadu_expats.py)

peoples_entries.name: Foreign Traders, Concessionaires & Envoys in Xanadu
peoples_entries.note: Treaty-port factors, concession engineers, mercenaries, and diplomatic envoys resident across Erewhon, Qiblai, Strongbow, Thalaba, Gihon, and Laitwal, blending homeland dress with Xanadu climatic & sumptuary adaptations (tools/garments/cultures/xanadu_expats.py)
